blocks.en: Two single-part arms separate the two parts of the warning; both were fixed before their first call (Supplementary Table 7). The instruction-only arm adds the check instruction to the unwarned prompt and keeps the unwarned status options. The schema-only arm uses the warned status field and defect type without the instruction. Both ran once on the nine original pairs for Fable 5.1, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5 and Opus 4.8, with the Tier-2 settings, on 30 September, about a day and a half after the first collection; the unwarned and warned cells are these models’ first runs. The unwarned repeats of Fable 5.1, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5 on the same nine twins give the run-to-run reference. Four exploratory contrasts on the flawed twins test the instruction with and without the warned schema and the schema with and without the instruction (exact McNemar, Holm-adjusted over the four).
blocks.zh: 两只单臂分开了警告的两部分;这两部分都是在第一次呼叫前被固定的(补充表7)。 仅指令臂会将检查指令添加到未警告的提示中,并保留未警告状态选项. 仅用于计程器的臂使用被警告状态字段和没有指令的缺陷类型. 两人于9月30日在Fable 5.1, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5和 Opus 4.8 的9个原配对上跑出一对,其中Tier 2 的设置在第一次收集后大约一天半;未警告和警告的细胞是这些模型的首次运行. 同一9个双胞胎身上的Fable 5.1,Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5等未加警告的重复给出了跑取的参考. 与有缺陷的双胞胎相比,有四个探索性对比是用和没有警告的策略来测试指令,有和没有指令的策略(精确的McNemar,Holm调整了四个).

blocks.en: A second collection tested the two confirmatory contrasts again; it was fixed before its first call (Supplementary Table 7). Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5.5 and Sonnet 5 each received a fresh unwarned run and a schema-only run on all 30 pairs, flawed and consistent twin, with the Tier-2 settings. For each model the two arms started together and ran concurrently in the same item order. A subscription usage limit paused all calls for about seven hours, so collection fell into two blocks (Supplementary Table 16); every arm has calls in both blocks except Opus 4.8’s schema-only arm, which finished in the first. At the restart, 137 calls failed with a command-line sign-in error before any model reply; they were rerun. A quota guard, set to keep a share of the weekly plan free, stopped the collection after 456 of the 480 planned calls: 23 of Sonnet 5’s unwarned calls and one of its schema-only calls are missing. The planned second fresh unwarned runs of Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5 (120 calls) were not made. The prespecified tests are the two contrasts on the 21 added pairs in each arm (exact McNemar, Holm over the four), the same contrasts on all 30 pairs as combined estimates, the schema-only arm against the fresh unwarned arm within each model (Holm over the four models) and the rejection counts of every unwarned run of each model; pairs with a missing call are left out of a contrast. The new replies are scored at the status level and are not coded.
blocks.zh: 第二次收集再次测试了两种确认对比;在第一次调用之前已经固定(补充表7)。 Opus 5,Opus 4.8,Sonnet 5.5和Sonnet 5各收到一款未经警告的新跑并对所有30对有缺陷且相容的双人只进行一款有计划跑跑,带有Tier-2设置. 对于每个型号,两只手臂一起起跑,并按同一项顺序同时运行。 订阅使用限制所有通话暂停了大约7小时,因此收集工作被分成了两个街区(补充表16);除了Opus 4.8的只设计划臂之外,每个臂都有两个街区的通话,第一个街区的通话完成。 在重启时,137个电话在任何模型回复前都以命令行的登录出错而失败;它们被重新运行. 一个固定在每周计划份额的配额警卫在计划拨打的480通电话中456通之后就停止了募集:Sonnet 5的23通未加警告的电话和它仅一个计划拨打的电话都不见了. 计划中的第二次未经警告的奥普斯4.8跑道和索内特5(120通电话)跑道并未出道. 预先确定的测试是每只手臂中21个加一对(精确为McNemar,Holm比四对)上的两个对比,所有30对的对比与综合估计的对比相同,每个模型中只有"有计划"的手臂与新鲜的无警告的手臂相对抗(Holm比四只模型相比),每个模型中每跑一跑一跑的被否决计数;缺一叫的一对则被忽略出对比. 新的答复是在状态级别上得到的,没有编码。

blocks.en: The export lists every unwarned miss from each model’s primary run, Tier-2 and Tier-1, with a random case identifier, the problem, the planted flaw and the reply. Timeouts, budget failures and harness failures are classed automatically and are not sent to the coders. The codebook’s decision order is: an explicit statement of the contradiction is “noted”; an explicit revealing check with the wrong conclusion is “misjudged”; a reply that uses the flawed datum as given is “adopted”; a reply that never touches it is “silent”. The three-class scheme of the main text merges adopted and silent, which the coders did not apply uniformly, into “unexamined”. It was chosen after the 28 four-class disagreements were visible, so it is a post-hoc primary analysis; on the 232 cases the coders agreed with κ = 0.89 \kappa=0.89 on three classes and κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81 on four (Supplementary Fig. 5). The coders are artificial intelligence (AI) models. Coder 1 was GPT-6-Sol through the Codex CLI at low effort. Coder 2 was Claude Sonnet 5.5 through the Claude CLI at medium effort. Both used the isolated backends. Agreed codes were kept. Each four-class disagreement was adjudicated by GPT-6-Astra through the isolated Codex CLI at high effort; it is a panel model, neither a coder nor the coding assistant, and was not involved in building or analysing the study (Use of AI tools). The adjudicator saw the codebook, four written rules, the problem, the planted flaw, the full reply and both coders’ labels, and was blind to model, run, item and the study’s aims; this arrangement was fixed before its output existed. An earlier adjudication by Claude Opus 5.5, the model behind the coding assistant, gave the same class on 26 of 28 cases and is superseded. An unblinded labelling of 42 cases by the coding assistant, made before the codebook was fixed, is not used (Supplementary Table 6).
blocks.zh: 导出列表列出每个模型主运行(Tier-2和Tier-1)中的所有未加警告的误差,并附有随机的大小写标识符、问题、所埋设的缺陷和答案。 超时,预算故障和被调用故障自动分类,不发送到编码器. 密码簿的决定命令是:明确声明矛盾是 " 注意到的 " ;明确披露与错误结论的核对是 " 错误判断的 " ;使用错误基准的答复是 " 采纳的 " ;从未触及的答复是 " 沉默 " 。 主文的三等办法将编码者没有统一适用的通过和沉默合并为“未经审查”。 这是在28个四等分歧明显后选择的,所以是后热初级分析;在232个案例中,编码员同意了"κ=0.89\kappa=0.89"三个类别,"κ=0.81\kappa=0.81"四个类别(补充图. 编码器是人工智能(AI)模型. 编码器1在低强度下通过Codex CLI是GPT-6-Sol. 代码2是克洛德·索内特5.5 通过克洛德CLI在中度努力。 两者都使用了被隔离的后端. 已保留商定的代码。 每个四级的分歧都由GPT-6-Astra通过孤立的Codex CLI在高强度下裁定;它是一个面板模型,既不是编码器,也不是编码助理,没有参与研究的建设或分析(使用AI工具). 裁判员看到了密码本,四个书面规则,问题,所埋设的缺陷,完整的答复和两个编码员的标签,对模型,运行,项目和研究的目的视而不见;这种安排在它的输出存在之前就已经固定了. 早期由克洛德·奥普斯·5.5(英语:Claude Opus 5.5)做出的裁决,编码助理背后的模型对28个案件中的26个案件给出了同样的等级,被取而代之. 未使用编码助理在编码本固定之前对42个案例的无盲标签(补充表6)。

blocks.en: The word lists and the repair rules above were written after the replies had been read, so both were checked by a second blinded double coding, fixed before any coder output existed (Supplementary Table 7). The export held every unwarned Tier-2 rejection of a flawed twin (289) and every Tier-2 miss coded noted (26), each with a random case identifier, the problem, the planted flaw and the full reply, and no model, run or item. A rejection reason was coded planted (the reply names the planted flaw in any wording), other defect (it claims a different defect), inability (it claims no defect and cites only the difficulty of computing) or unclear. A noted reply was coded repair (it states a corrected or attainable version and its answers fit that version), continuation (its answers are for the state the flaw makes impossible or use the flawed datum) or unclear. Coders, adjudicator, backends and effort settings were those of the miss coding. The coders agreed on all 289 reason classes ( κ = 1.00 \kappa=1.00 ) and on 25 of the 26 noted replies ( κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 ); GPT-6-Astra adjudicated the one disagreement. The coded reason class equals the word-list class for all 289 rejections, so every contrast is unchanged. For noted replies the coded class is used: it equals the rule class for 21 of the 22 replies the rules decide and assigns the four they leave as other.
blocks.zh: 上面的单词和修补规则都是在答复被读取后编写的,所以都用第二个被蒙蔽的双码检查,在任何编码器输出存在之前固定(补充表7)。 导出时,每个未加警告的Tier-2拒绝一个有缺陷的双胞胎(289个),每个Tier-2丢失一个编码(26个),每个都带有随机的大小写标识符、问题、所植入的缺陷和完整的回答,没有模型、运行或项目。 一种拒绝理由被编入密码(答复名称是任何措辞中被编入的缺陷)、其他缺陷(它声称有不同的缺陷)、无法(它声称没有缺陷,只提到计算困难)或不明确。 已注意到的回复是编码修复(它说明一个经更正或可实现的版本,其答案与该版本相符)、继续(其答复针对的状态是缺陷无法弥补或使用有缺陷的基准)或不明确。 编码员、裁判员、后端和工作设置是错的编码。 编码员同意了所有289个理由类别(ob = 1.00\kappa=1.00)和26个注解答复中的25个(ob = 0.92\kappa=0.92);GPT-6-Astra裁定了这一分歧。 编码后的理由类等于所有289个拒绝的单词列表类,因此每个对比都保持不变. 对于注意的答复,使用编码类:在22份答复中,21份的编码类等于规则类,由规则决定,并将它们离开的4份定为其他。

blocks.en: OpenSees (Open System for Earthquake Engineering Simulation), through its Python interface OpenSeesPy 3.8.0.0, repeats T02, T04 and T08 (main-text references 62, 63). T02 is a frame with zero-length elastic–perfectly plastic hinges; it checks the first-hinge factor and location, the collapse factor and the residual moment, and brackets the shakedown factor by cyclic simulation at 0.97 ​ λ s ​ d 0.97\,\lambda_{sd} and 1.03 ​ λ s ​ d 1.03\,\lambda_{sd} , up to 150 cycles. T04 uses compression-only springs at 5 mm spacing and checks contact length, peak reaction, largest sagging moment and end uplift. T08 uses corotational beams (main-text references 64) under displacement control, with a 10 − 3 ​ h 10^{-3}h antisymmetric imperfection, and checks the instability mode and critical force but not the midpoint displacement, axial force or clamp moment. Agreement tolerances are 0.1–0.2% for T02 and T04, and 3% for T08, where the keys use shallow-arch kinematics and the finite-element model does not. Flaw certificates are positive checks: for a T02 flaw, OpenSees must collapse before the stated load factor; for a T04 flaw, the gauged end must lift; for a T08 flaw, the force must rise monotonically to a stroke of twice the rise. T11 and T12 are not in this suite.
blocks.zh: OpenSees (Open System for Equake Engineering Simulation),通过其Python接口OpenSees 3.8.0.0重复了T02,T04和T08(主文参考62,63). T02是一个有零长弹性-完美塑料链的帧;它检查了一指因子和位置,倒塌因子和剩余瞬间,并用循环模拟来将摇动因子括为0.97 s d 0.97\,\lambda\sd}和1.03 s d 1.03\,\lambda\sd}最多150个周期. T04使用5毫米相距的只压缩弹簧并检查接触长度,峰值反应,最大下沉瞬间并最后升起. T08在流离失所控制下使用皮质束(主文参考64),有10−3 h 10^{-3}h反对称的不完善,并检查不稳定模式和关键力量,而不是中位流离失所、轴力或夹克瞬间。 T02和T04的协议能耐为0.1-0.2%,T08为3%,其中密钥使用浅结构动能,而有限元素模型不使用. Flaw证书是正检:对于一个T02缺陷,OpenSees必须在所声明的负载系数之前倒塌;对于一个T04缺陷,被测量的端必须被抬起;对于一个T08缺陷,被测量的端必须被单调地提升到上升两倍的中风. T11和T12不在此套房内.

blocks.en: main-text Table 2 lists the panel, Supplementary Table 9 the model identifiers passed to each CLI and Supplementary Table 2 the harness settings. Anthropic models used the Claude Code CLI with an empty tool list, no project memory and no hooks; the CLI binary on the machine was dated 25 September 2026, and the version string of each call was not recorded. OpenAI GPT-6 and GPT-5 models used the Codex CLI (0.158.0) with tools, web search and user configuration disabled, in a read-only sandbox and an ephemeral session. Gemini and gpt-oss-120b used the Antigravity CLI (1.2.13), which cannot disable tools but logs every tool step. Nine Gemini 3.8 Flash calls logged a tool step; none returned a usable answer, and each is graded as a failure. No reply that used a tool is counted as correct or as a rejection. Isolation probes confirmed the Claude and Codex settings; the probe records will be released with the code after this preprint is posted.
blocks.zh: 表2列出了面板、补充表9、发给每个CLI的模型标识符和补充表2的吊带设置。 Anthropic模型使用 Claude 代码 CLI ,其工具列表为空,没有项目内存,也没有钩子;机器上的 CLI 二进制日期为2026年9月25日,没有记录每个调用的版本字符串. OpenAI GPT-6和GPT-5型号使用Codex CLI (0.158.0),在只读取的沙盒和麻黄会话中取消了工具,网页搜索和用户配置. 双子座和gpt-oss-120b使用Antigravity CLI(1.2.13),它不能禁用工具而记录每个工具步骤. 九个双子座 3.8 Flash呼叫记录了一个工具步骤;没有一个返回一个可用的答案,每个被分级为失败. 任何使用工具的答复都不算正确或拒绝。 孤立探测器确认了克洛德和Codex的设置;在此预印后,将随密码发布探测器记录.

blocks.en: These analyses use the existing replies and were defined after the replies had been read. They are exploratory; the analysis code and every assignment will be released with the benchmark after this preprint is posted. A pair is co-solved when both models of a contrast answer its consistent twin correctly; the contrasts are repeated on co-solved pairs. The reason of each rejection is matched against two word lists: phrases that name the planted flaw of the family (for example “gauge”, “inconsistent” and “contradict” for T04, or “burst”, “collapse” and “no equilibrium” for T11) and phrases that cite only the difficulty of computing (“without computational tools”, “by hand”, “beyond the scope”). A rejection whose reason matches only the second list is an inability rejection. Recognition of the planted flaw counts a rejection whose reason names the planted flaw, or a miss coded “noted”; a rejection that claims a different defect is not recognition.
blocks.zh: 这些分析使用现有答复,在阅读答复后加以界定。 它们是探索性的;分析代码和每项任务将在预印后随基准发布. 当两个模型的对比都正确回答其一致的双对时,一对是共解的;而对比则在共解对上重复. 每项拒绝的理由与两个单词清单相匹配:将家庭的缺陷归为一词(例如,T04的“错误”、“不一致”和“争议”,或T11的“爆发”、“崩溃”和“无平衡”),以及只列举计算困难(“没有计算工具”、“手”、“超出范围”等)。 理由只符合第二名单的拒绝就是无法拒绝。 承认所埋设的缺陷,就等于拒绝,其理由名称为所埋设的缺陷,或误用“已注意到的”;拒绝,声称有不同缺陷,则不是承认。

blocks.en: Each Tier-2 miss coded “noted” is compared with the attainable readings of its flawed statement. For T04, the consistent twin shares every datum except the gauge, so its key is the lift-off solution with the gauge set aside; a reply whose answers all pass main-text equation 2 against that key is a repair. For T02, only the residual moment depends on the load factor; a residual within tolerance of unloading from the collapse state, M ⁡ ( λ c ) − λ c ​ M E M(\lambda_{c})-\lambda_{c}M^{E} , is a repair, and one within tolerance of the collapse moments unloaded by the unattainable factor, M ⁡ ( λ c ) − λ 1 ​ M E M(\lambda_{c})-\lambda_{1}M^{E} , is a continuation. For T12, a reply that returns zero residual fit pressure and zero service lift-off speed treats the fit as loose and is a repair. T08 and T11 have no attainable reading of the requested state, so numbers returned for them are continuations. Anything else is “other”.

T08和T11对所请求的状态没有可实现的读取,因此为它们回取的数字是续作. 其他的都是“其他”。

blocks.en: The analysis plan was written on 29 September 2026, after the solve items and the original nine flaw pairs had been scored and before the 21 added pairs existed. Six contrasts were named then: Opus 5.5 versus Opus 5, Opus 5 versus Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5.5 versus Sonnet 5, GPT-6-Sol versus GPT-5.6-Sol, GPT-6-Astra versus GPT-6-Sol, and Opus 5.5 versus GPT-6-Astra. Holm adjustment is applied inside each family of six. The six solve-accuracy contrasts are exploratory, because those items already existed. The six rejection contrasts are confirmatory only on the 21 added pairs; the pooled 30-pair splits are the combined estimate. All-pairs tests, 91 on solve accuracy and 91 on rejection across the 14 models, are exploratory, as are the twin controls above. The design-level statement uses an exact two-sided sign test over the five flaw designs. Four claims of the study protocol are not tested here: accuracy against cost across effort levels, the correction step of the critique arm, self-correction follow-ups and defects invisible to final-answer grading (Supplementary Table 7).
blocks.zh: 分析计划是在2026年9月29日,在解题和最初的9个瑕疵对被打出后,在21个加分对存在前所写出. 当时命名了六个对比: Opus 5.5对 Opus 5.5对 Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5.5对 Sonnet 5. GPT-6-Sol对 GPT-5.6-Sol, GPT-6-Astra对 GPT-6-Sol, Opus 5.5对 GPT-6-Astra. 6个家庭都采用混合调整。 六个解析准确性对比是探索性的,因为这些项目已经存在。 六个拒绝对比仅在21个新增对上进行确认;集合30-平分是合并估计. 全平面测试,91个关于解析精度测试和91个关于14个模型的拒绝测试,都是探索性的,上面的双重控制也是如此。 设计级别语句在五个缺陷设计上采用了精确的双面标志测试. 这里没有测试研究协议的4项索赔:准确性与不同努力水平的费用比较、批评臂的纠正步骤、自我纠正后续措施以及最后回答分级中看不到的缺陷(补充表7)。

blocks.en: The following protocol details accompany the concise Methods in the main text.

blocks.en: Main-text Table 2 lists the panel. Anthropic models used Claude Code with tools, memory and hooks disabled; OpenAI models used Codex with tools, web search and configuration disabled, in ephemeral sessions. Gemini and gpt-oss-120b used Antigravity, whose tools cannot be disabled. No reply using a tool counted as correct or as a rejection. Isolation probes checked Claude and Codex; the probe records will be released with the code after this preprint is posted. Binary identifiers, isolation settings and observed tool calls are specified in Supplementary Note 3 and Supplementary Tables 2 and 9.
blocks.zh: 表2列出面板。 Anthropic模型使用 Claude 代码,工具,内存和钩子被禁用;OpenAI模型使用 Codex ,工具,网络搜索和配置被禁用,在麻黄会话中. 双子座和gpt-oss-120b使用了Antigravity,其工具不能被禁用. 没有使用被计算为正确或拒绝的工具作出答复。 孤立探测器检查了克洛德和克洛德克克思;在此预印后,将随密码发布探测器记录. 二进制标识符,隔离设置和被观察到的工具调用在"补充说明"3和"补充表2"和"表9"中都有规定.

blocks.en: Reasoning effort was high where configurable; no sampling temperature or seed was set. Time limits were 1800 s on Tier 1 and 2700 s on Tier 2. Timeouts and exhausted output budgets are failures. Transport retries, non-answer rules, incomplete models and deviations are recorded in Supplementary Note 3 and Table 7. The first scored reply counts.
blocks.zh: 合理的努力在可配置的地方很高;没有设定取样温度或种子。 1800秒为1级,2700秒为2级。 暂停和耗尽的产出预算都是失败。 运输回溯、非回答规则、不完整模型和偏差记录在补充说明3和表7中。 第一个得分的回答数。

blocks.en: The system prompt is fixed: an instruction to act as a mechanical engineer and to finish with one JSON object in a fenced block. Tier 2 appends one sentence: no tools, no code execution, no internet, calculations in the reply itself. The sentence was added after a probe returned a fabricated tool call and no answer.
blocks.zh: 系统提示被固定:指示充当机械工程师,并用一个被栅栏围起来的JSON物体完成. 第二级附加了一句话:没有工具,没有代码执行,没有互联网,在回复本身中计算. 句子是被探测器返回了被编造的工具呼叫而无答案后添加的.

blocks.en: Two single-part arms test the warning components: instruction-only adds the check instruction while keeping the unwarned status options; schema-only changes the status field without the check instruction. Each ran once on the original nine pairs for five Anthropic models, using Tier-2 settings. They were fixed before their first call but collected about a day and a half after the original unwarned and warned runs, so their counts alone cannot separate the components’ causal effects. The four exploratory paired contrasts and collection details are specified in Supplementary Note 3 and Supplementary Table 15.
blocks.zh: 两个单段武器测试 警告组件: 仅指令在保留未警告状态选项的同时添加检查指令; 仅计划更改状态域而不检查指令. 每个都运行在最初的9对上,用于5个Anthropic模型,使用Tier-2设置. 他们被固定在第一次通话之前,但在最初未警告和警告的运行之后大约一天半的时间里收集到,因此仅凭他们的计算无法区分组件的因果关系。 补充说明3和补充表15详细列出了四个探索性对等对比和收集细节。

blocks.en: A second collection retested the two version contrasts in fresh unwarned and schema-only arms, fixed before calls (Supplementary Table 7). Each of four models received 30 consistent/flawed pairs; its arms started together and followed the same item order over two time blocks. Quotas left 456 of 480 calls; Sonnet 5 lacks 23 unwarned calls and one schema-only call. Further older-model repeats were not made. Prespecified paired tests compare versions on the 21 added pairs, and arms within models, each Holm-adjusted over four contrasts. Missing calls are excluded; new replies are not coded. Supplementary Note 3 and Table 16 give interruptions, timings and combined estimates.

blocks.en: In T04 the consistent twin states the dial-gauge reading that the flawed twin contradicts. In five of the six T04 pairs the gauged end is the end that rises most, so the stated reading equals the graded uplift to within 0.2% and the sign of the reading shows which end lifts. The T04 consistent twin therefore states one graded answer and part of another. The co-solved contrasts are repeated without T04 (Supplementary Table 14), and Supplementary Table 10 compares the uplift answers on T04 solve items and consistent twins: older models score that answer more often on the twins than on the solve items.
blocks.zh: 在T04中,一致的双胞胎表示拨号读取有缺陷的双胞胎矛盾. 在六对T04中的五对中,被测量的末端是升起最多的末端,所以所声明的读取值等于分级升起值到0.2%以内,读取值的标语显示到底升起值. 因此,T04一致的双胞胎表示一个分级答案,另一个分级答案的一部分。 共解对比重复了没有T04(补充表14),而补充表10则比较了T04解项和相容双胞胎上的提升答案:比起解项更经常回答双胞胎的更老模型得分.

blocks.en: A noted reply is a repair when its numbers match a physically attainable, corrected problem within main-text equation 2. Rules test the gauge-free lift-off solution (T04), elastic unloading from collapse (T02), or a loose fit (T12). Numbers for the impossible state are continuations; undecided replies are “other”. T08 and T11 have no attainable version of the requested state. Supplementary Note 3 gives the exact numerical rules.
blocks.zh: 注意的回答是,当其数字与可实际实现的、经更正的主要文字方程式中的问题相匹配时,即是一种修复。 2. 联合国 规则测试无表起降溶液(T04),从倒塌后弹性卸下(T02),或松散放放放(T12). 无法状态的数字是连续数;未决定的答复是“其他”。 T08和T11没有可实现的被请求状态版本. 补充说明3给出了准确的数字规则。

blocks.en: Two blinded AI coders labelled every usable unwarned miss from the primary runs, with model, run and item identifiers hidden. Non-answers were classed automatically. The three-class scheme merges adopted and silent replies after four-class disagreements were visible, so it is exploratory. On 232 cases, agreement was κ = 0.89 \kappa=0.89 for three classes and 0.81 for four (Supplementary Fig. 5). GPT-6-Sol and Claude Sonnet 5.5 coded; GPT-6-Astra adjudicated blindly under a fixed protocol. No human expert validated the labels. Supplementary Note 3 retains the codebook, effort settings, adjudicator inputs and superseded analyses.
blocks.zh: 有两个被蒙蔽的AI编码器标记了主运行中每个可使用而无警告的误差,并隐藏了模型,运行和项目标识符. 非回答自动分类。 三等计划合并,在四等分歧明显后无声回答,所以是探索性的. 在232个案件中,协议为3个类别=0.89\kappa=0.89,4个类别为0.81(补充图5)。 GPT-6-Sol和Claude Sonnet 5.5编码;GPT-6-Astra在固定协议下盲目裁定. 没有人类专家验证这些标签。 补充说明3保留了代码簿、工作设置、裁判员投入和被取代的分析。

blocks.en: A separately fixed blinded double coding checked the post-hoc rejection word lists and repair rules (Supplementary Table 7). It covered all 289 unwarned Tier-2 rejections and 26 noted misses, using the same coders and adjudicator. Agreement was complete for rejection reasons ( κ = 1.00 \kappa=1.00 ) and 25 of 26 for repairs ( κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 ). Word-list and coded rejection classes match throughout, leaving contrasts unchanged. Repairs use the coded class. Supplementary Note 3 defines classes, export fields and comparison with the numerical rules.
blocks.zh: 单独固定的双盲码检查了Hoc后拒绝单词列表和修复规则(补充表7)。 它涵盖所有289个未警告的2级拒绝和26个已注意到的遗漏,使用相同的编码员和裁判员。 由于拒绝原因,协议完成(ob = 1.00\kappa = 1.00),修理26个中的25个(ob = 0.92\kappa = 0.92). 单词和编码的拒绝类完全匹配,对比不变. 修理使用已编码的类别。 补充说明3界定了类别、出口领域和与数字规则的比较。

blocks.en: The plan was written after the solve items and original nine pairs were scored, but before the 21 added pairs existed. It named six contrasts (Supplementary Table 4), with Holm adjustment within each set. Solve contrasts are exploratory; rejection contrasts are confirmatory only on the added pairs, with 30-pair results as combined estimates. All-pairs comparisons and twin controls are exploratory. The five-design analysis uses an exact two-sided sign test. Supplementary Note 3 retains contrast definitions and planned endpoints outside this paper.
blocks.zh: 计划是在解题后被写出并被打出9对原作后被写出,但在21对所添加的对已存在之前. 它列出了6个对照(补充表4),每套内有Holm调整. 溶解对比是探索性的;拒绝对比只在所加入的对上进行确认,30-pair结果作为综合估计. 全方位比对和双控都是探索性的. 五德设计分析采用精确的双面标志测试. 补充说明3保留了本文件以外的对比定义和计划终点。

Colour is the change from that rule. No model pair reverses order between factors 1 and 5. The largest move in that range is four additional items, for Sonnet 5.

blocks.en: Supplementary Figure 2: Third-party verification. Relative difference between OpenSees and the answer key for every checked quantity, with counts of the qualitative checks (shakedown bracket, flaw reproduced, mode match). T08 compares exact beam kinematics with the keys’ shallow-arch model. The two points above 1% are imperfection-sensitive bifurcation loads, accepted at a 3% tolerance. Sixty-two checks, no failures. T11 and T12 are not in this figure.
blocks.zh: 补充图 2:第三方核查。 OpenSees和每个被检查数量的答案密钥之间的相对差异,包含质量检查的计数(摇倒括号,复制缺陷,模式匹配). T08将精确的光束动能与密钥的浅轴模型进行比较. 1%以上的两点是不完善的敏感接发负载,以3%的能耐接受. 62张支票,没有失败。 T11和T12不在此数字中.

blocks.en: Supplementary Figure 3: Tier-2 solve accuracy by family. Items correct out of five in each family. On the primary run, Gemini 3.8 Flash solved none of the five T08 items.
blocks.zh: 补充图3:按家庭分列的第二级精确度。 每个家庭的5个项目都正确 在主跑中,双子座 3.8 Flash 解决了5个T08项目中的任何一个.

blocks.en: Supplementary Figure 4: Tier-1 flaw handling. Critique pairs (detect the implanted error, locate the first wrong step, false alarm on the clean solution) and premise pairs, unwarned and warned (reject: the flawed statement is rejected; false alarm: the consistent statement is rejected). Premise rejection shows the same warned-versus-unwarned gap as Tier 2, at 20 pairs.
blocks.zh: 补充图4:第一级缺陷处理。 严格对称(检测被植入的错误,定位出第一个错误的步骤,在干净的溶液上出现虚假的警报)和前提对,没有警告和警告(拒绝:有缺陷的声明被拒绝;虚假的警告:一致的声明被拒绝). 预先拒绝显示与第2级相同,20对的警告和未警告差距。

blocks.en: Supplementary Figure 5: Coder agreement. Confusion matrix of the two blinded coders over 232 missed flaws. Three-class κ = 0.89 \kappa=0.89 . Four-class κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81 . The off-diagonal mass in the four-class matrix sits on the adopted/silent boundary, which the primary scheme merges.
blocks.zh: 补充图 5: 编码协议. 232个失明编码器的迷惑矩阵 错过了缺陷 三等同为0.89\kappa=0.89. 四等同为0.81\kappa=0.81. 四等矩阵中的离对角质量坐落在被采纳/沉积的边界上,由主方案合并.

blocks.en: Supplementary Figure 6: Item-level consistency. Each Tier-2 solve item in each of three runs, for the seven models that were repeated. A cell is one item in one run. GPT-6-Astra has no flips. GPT-6-Sol flips on eight items, which is why pass 3 \mathrm{pass}^{3} falls from a primary score of 23/25 to 16/25.
blocks.zh: 补充图6:项目一级的一致性。 每3个运行中每个第二级解析项目,用于重复的7个模型. 单元格是运行中的一个项目。 GPT-6-Astra没有翻转. GPT-6-Sol在8个项目上翻转,这就是为什么通过 3\mathrm{pass}^{3}从主分23/25降至16/25.

blocks.en: Supplementary tables
blocks.zh: 补充表格

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 1: Tier-1 families. Hard-10 is the hardest tenth of a 1280-item pool, selected by a model-free score and frozen before any model call. The evaluation slice used here is 52 solve items, 21 critique pairs and 20 premise pairs.
blocks.zh: 补充表格 1: 第一级家庭。 Hard-10是1280个物品池中最困难的第十个,由无模型分数选择,并在任何模型调用前被冻结. 这里使用的评价片是52个解题,21个批判对和20个前提对.

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 2: Harness settings that affect comparability. Wall time is the common unit across providers. Token counts are not. “Output tokens” include thinking in all three harnesses, on different tokenizers. CLI, command line interface.
blocks.zh: 补充表格 2: 影响可比性的调和设置. 墙上时间是提供商之间的常见单位. 托肯数不是。 " 产出标志 " 包括在所有三个工具中用不同的标志来思考。 CLI,命令行接口.

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 3: Tier-2 rates with Wilson 95% intervals. Solve items are the 25 Tier-2 solve problems. Unwarned rejection (flawed twins) and false alarms (consistent twins) are out of 30 pairs for all 14 models. Gemini 3.1 Pro was not run on Tier 1 and is included here.
blocks.zh: 补充表3:第二级费率,间隔为Wilson 95%。 解决的项目是25 Tier-2 解决的问题. 无预警的拒绝(flawed twins)和假警报(Consistent twins)为全部14个模型的30对. 双子座3.1 Pro没有在1级上运行,并包含在此.

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 4: Contrasts. Exact McNemar tests, Holm-adjusted within the six contrasts for that outcome. Counts are discordant items (only the first model right, then only the second). The six contrasts were fixed on 29 September 2026, after the solve items and the original nine flaw pairs had been scored and before the 21 added pairs existed. Solve accuracy is exploratory. Rejection on the 21 added pairs is the confirmatory test. Rejection on all 30 pairs is the combined estimate. The same contrasts under the twin controls are in Supplementary Table 14.
blocks.zh: 补充表4:对比。 精确的麦克尼玛测试,Holm调整 在六个对比度内 对于这个结果。 计数是相不相通的项目(只有第一个模型对了,然后只有第二个). 6个对比点在2026年9月29日被固定,在解题项和最初的9个瑕疵对被打出后和21个加分对存在前. 解决的准确性是探索性的。 21个新增对上的拒绝是确认测试. 全部30对的拒绝是综合估计. 补充表14显示在双重控制下的相同对比。

blocks.en: An item random-intercept logistic model on the solve items was fitted by maximum a posteriori estimation, the marginal likelihood taken by non-adaptive 30-point Gauss–Hermite quadrature, with a normal prior of mean 0 and standard deviation 2.5 on the model effects. The item-difficulty standard deviation is 0.79 on the logit scale. Model effects (logit, standard error) run from + 3.89 +3.89 (1.16) for Opus 5 and GPT-6-Astra, through + 0.03 +0.03 (0.45) for Sonnet 5, to − 3.98 -3.98 (1.16) for Haiku 4.5 and gpt-oss-120b. The fit converged. It is a description of the spread, not a ranking test.
blocks.zh: 溶解物上的随机截取后勤模型通过最大后期估计,即非适应性30分高斯-赫米特四分法所承受的边际可能性,在模型效果上通常为中值0和标准偏差2.5。 项-难度标准偏差为0.79的对数尺度. 模型效应(logit,标准出错)从Opus 5和GPT-6-Astra的+ 3.89 + 3.89 (1.16)起,再到Sonnet 5的+ 0.03 + 0.03(0.45)起,再到- 3.98-3.98 (1.16)的Haiku 4.5和gpt-oss-120b起. 适来相会. 这是对传播的描述,而不是排名测试。

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 5: Parser census, scored replies. The grader uses the last fenced JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) block and also accepts bare JSON. A seeded random sample of 50 replies, stratified by harness (seed 20260930), matched the graded value in every case. The flagged set (0 unit-scale slips, 4 sign flips, 35 answers whose correct value appears elsewhere in the reply) was reviewed separately; none was a parser error. The census covers the primary panel runs only. The single-part arms (180 calls) gave 178 fenced replies and two non-answers; the second collection (456 final calls) gave 447 fenced replies, one unparsed reply and eight non-answers.
blocks.zh: 补充表5:解析器普查,得分答复. 分级器使用最后一个有栅栏的JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) 块并同时接受赤裸的JSON. 随机抽取了50个答复的种子样本,通过抽取进行分级(种子20260930),与每个案例的分级值相匹配。 标有标记的套件(0个单位级滑动,4个符号翻转,35个答案,其正确值出现在答复的其他地方)被分别审查;无一是解析错误. 普查只包括主要小组。 单段武器(180通电话)给出了178个有栅栏的回信和2个无栅栏的回信;第二集(456通最后回信)给出了447个有栅栏的回信,1个无栅栏的回信和8个无栅栏的回信.

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 6: Coding of missed flaws. Both coders labelled 232 cases. The three-class scheme merges adopted and silent into “unexamined” and was adopted after the four-class disagreements were seen. The 28 four-class disagreements were adjudicated by GPT-6-Astra, neither a coder nor the coding assistant, blind to model, run, item and the study’s aims. A first adjudication by Claude Opus 5.5, the model behind the coding assistant, gave the same class on 26 of 28 cases and on 28 of 28 under the three-class scheme. An earlier unblinded labelling of 42 cases by the coding assistant, made before the codebook was fixed, is not used; it agrees with the two coders at three-class κ = 0.76 \kappa=0.76 and 0.69 0.69 (four-class 0.39 and 0.37), and all 13 cases it called noted are noted for both coders.
blocks.zh: 补充表格 6:错失缺陷的编码. 两个编码器都标有232个案例. 三等办法合并为“未经审查的”三等办法,并在看到四等的分歧后通过。 GPT-6-Astra裁定了28起四等争议,既不是编码员,也不是编码助理,对模型、运行、项目和研究的目的视而不见。 由编码助理背后的模型克洛德·奥普斯·5.5(英语:Claude Opus 5.5 (film))所作的第一次判决,在"三等"方案下,对28个案件中的26个案件和28个案件的28个案件给出了同样的等级. 编码助理早先对42个案例的未盲标签,在编码本被固定之前制作的,没有使用;它同意两个编码器的三等分=0.76\kappa=0.76和0.69 0.69(四等分0.39和0.37),它提到的所有13个案例都标注在两个编码器上.
